hooks.command: echo '⛰️ Melted Peak booting...'; echo ''; if [ -f active/active_context.md ]; then echo '--- Active Context ---'; head -30 active/active_context.md; echo ''; fi; if [ -f memory/session_handoff.md ]; then echo '--- Session Handoff ---'; head -30 memory/session_handoff.md; echo ''; fi; if [ -f active/active_issue.md ] && ! grep -q 'No active issue' active/active_issue.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '--- Active Issue ---'; head -20 active/active_issue.md; echo ''; fi

FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qvE '(active/|memory/|docs/|incoming/|\.claude/|\.claude-plugin/|CLAUDE\.md|README\.md|QUICKSTART\.md|\.gitkeep|\.gitignore|peaks/|hooks/)' && [ ! -s active/change_plan.md ] || grep -q 'No active change plan' active/change_plan.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK WARNING: You are modifying a code file without a change plan. Write a plan to active/change_plan.md first (exempt: typos, comments, formatting).'; fi

FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qvE '(active/|memory/|docs/|incoming/|\.claude/|\.claude-plugin/|peaks/|hooks/)'; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK: File modified outside system. Update active/active_context.md and append to memory/recent_deltas.md.'; fi

if [ -f active/active_issue.md ] && grep -c '### Attempt' active/active_issue.md 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^[3-9]'; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK: THREE-STRIKE WARNING -- 3+ attempts logged in active_issue.md. Consider stopping to analyze root cause per docs/core/15_error_recovery_protocol.md'; fi

if grep -q 'No previous session\|awaiting first task\|Awaiting task' memory/session_handoff.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK: Session ending without handoff. Run the handoff protocol: update memory/session_handoff.md, memory/progress_log.md, and active/active_context.md.'; fi
if git -C . status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^'; then echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK: Uncommitted changes detected. Consider committing before ending the session.'; fi

echo '⚡ MELTED PEAK: Context compaction imminent. Preserving critical state.'; echo ''; echo '--- PRESERVE THIS CONTEXT ---'; echo ''; if [ -f active/active_context.md ]; then echo '## Active Context'; head -40 active/active_context.md; echo ''; fi; if [ -f active/active_issue.md ] && ! grep -q 'No active issue' active/active_issue.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '## Active Issue'; head -30 active/active_issue.md; echo ''; fi; if [ -f active/change_plan.md ] && ! grep -q 'No active change plan' active/change_plan.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '## Change Plan'; head -30 active/change_plan.md; echo ''; fi; echo '## Boot Reminder'; echo 'After compaction, re-read: active/active_context.md, memory/session_handoff.md, active/active_issue.md'; echo '--- END PRESERVE ---'
